description: A locked field an invariant reads, given a call of a `function` of compile-time constants that reads nothing live (`<w b=(seed(2))/>`): accepted (it tracks nothing; the construction check holds it).
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-derived-split: only "a field that tracks a cell or a live use-site value stays refused" — a call that reads nothing live, at any depth, tracks nothing.
